0022600124.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-1, 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, 9th in the West) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West) for the Suns' third game of the season, with Oklahoma City on a two-game winning streak and 1-0 at home. For Phoenix, Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and a game-time decision. Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery), while Cason Wallace and Jaylin Williams are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and Phoenix lost 2-3 to Oklahoma City in the 2025-26 regular season and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 131-122 loss in Phoenix on April 27, 2026.
